title: Yani Neko
synopsis:
The life of a catgirl named Yaniko "Yani Neko" Satou revolves solely around one thing: cigarettes. Due to her severe smoking addiction that causes extreme withdrawal symptoms, she struggles to lead a normal life. Even worse, she lives in a run-down apartment, is constantly low on funds, and even the most basic daily activities are a hurdle for her. Although her best attempts to stop smoking have not worked despite the many interventions from the people close to her, Yani Neko swears to quit one day—but her ambitious goal seems to drift further out of reach with every cigarette.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
